periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downwards towards the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertical primary axis approximately 1.5 times the length of the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering observed, particularly on the interior margins adjacent to the rostrum.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curvature on the posterior edge of the transverse band across the scapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately one-third of the visible torso length at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, with an inter-ear gap roughly equivalent to the width of the cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and rounded apex curvature with no visible flattening or jagged edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-buff chromatic variation on the abdominal and lower thoracic fur compared to the white cranial fur.
